sources.snippet: Introduction LLaDA-Image is a competitive 6B-parameter open-source unified image generation and editing model family. It includes LLaDA-Image, a 50-step Base model for high-quality text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing, and LLaDA-Image-Turbo, a 4-step distilled model for fast generation and editing.
